description: This file defines a Recipient class for email handling within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It encapsulates recipient details such as email address, name, and first name, and extends an abstract recipient class.

classes.name: Recipient
classes.description: Represents an email recipient with properties for email address, name, and first name, extending the AbstractRecipient base class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Recipient instance with email address, name, and first name.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the recipient.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the recipient.
